R-AVAIL every train leg is confirmed (AVL with enough seats); RAC and waitlist do not count. R-OPEN sights on open days, within hours, for their full visit length.
R-SEASON sights in season and seasonal roads open. R-REST rest days (no leg over 2 hours, no ticketed sight). R-OCC rooms hold at most 3 guests and cover everyone; every leg is ticketed for exactly the right people.

R-ALT altitude pacing (the day you reach Leh is rest only; nothing higher than Leh, here above 3,500 m, before day 3). R-PERMIT permits booked at least a day ahead. I've put together a 4-day plan for 2 adults and 1 child (age 8) that comes to about **Rs 16,300**, well under your Rs 30,000 budget. Both train legs show confirmed seats. All bookings are made today, 15 Nov 2026, in the regular (General) quota.

**Day 1 – Sat 5 Dec: Delhi to Agra**
- Train 17946, chair car (CC), leaves 09:30 and arrives 12:52. Seats are confirmed. Your child travels at half fare without a seat of their own.
- Agra Fort, 14:00–16:00.
- Night at Hotel Grand Agra (H-AGRA-2), one room for all 3 of you.

**Day 2 – Sun 6 Dec: Agra**
- Taj Mahal, 08:00–10:30. It's closed on Fridays, so Sunday works.
- Second night at Hotel Grand Agra.

**Day 3 – Mon 7 Dec: Agra to Jaipur**
- Train 13048, chair car, leaves 05:30 and arrives 09:26. Seats are confirmed, child at half fare. The 06:15 train was waitlisted, so this early one is the only confirmed morning option.
- Hawa Mahal, 10:30–11:30, then City Palace, 12:00–14:00.
- Night at Hotel Lotus Jaipur (H-JAIP-1), one room for 3.

**Day 4 – Tue 8 Dec: Jaipur**
- Amber Fort, 09:00–11:30. The trip ends in Jaipur. It doesn't include a ride home.

**Cost breakdown (approx.)**
| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Trains | 1,813 |
| Hotels (3 nights, budget hotels) | 3,020 |
| Sightseeing tickets (child at half price) | 7,875 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day) | 3,600 |
| **Total** | **≈ 16,308** |

**Things to know:**
- Hotel Grand Agra has no lift and no ground-floor rooms. Hotel Lotus Jaipur has no lift but does have ground-floor rooms. Amber Fort isn't wheelchair-accessible.
- You have about Rs 13,700 left in the budget, enough to move up to better hotels if you'd like.

**The plan (2 adults, booked today, 2026-11-15)**

| Date | Travel | Sights | Night |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 28 Dec | Train 17469, Delhi 13:10 → Jaipur 18:13, chair car (CC) | – | Hotel Courtyard Jaipur |
| Tue 29 Dec | – | Amber Fort 08:30–11:00, City Palace 12:00–14:00, Hawa Mahal 14:30–15:30 | Hotel Courtyard Jaipur |

**Why it's set up this way**
- **Jodhpur to Udaipur is by taxi:** every train that day was waitlisted or RAC (not confirmed). The taxi leaves after Mehrangarh Fort and arrives at 17:33.
- **You leave Udaipur a day early, on 1 Jan:** there are no flights from Udaipur to Delhi on 2 Jan. The 2 Jan trains would only get you to Delhi on 3 Jan, after the trip ends. So you'll spend 2 Jan travelling and arriving in Delhi.
- **Jodhpur gets one morning:** the only Jaipur–Jodhpur train with confirmed seats gets in at 21:57. Jaswant Thada isn't included.
- **Hotels are mid-range.** All three serve vegetarian food.

**Rough cost breakdown (Rs)**
- Trains: about 5,210 (930 + 1,040 + 3,240)
- Taxi: 4,400 for the car
- Hotels: about 12,805 (Jaipur 6,460 for 2 nights, Jodhpur 2,755, Udaipur 3,590)
- Entry tickets: about 6,200 for both of you
- Food allowance: about 7,200 (Rs 600 per person per day)

- **Taxi:** leaves Kochi at 08:00 and reaches Munnar at 12:35.

- **Hotel:** H-MUNN-1, Hotel Orchid Munnar, Rs 1,080.

- **Taxi:** leaves Munnar at 08:00 and reaches Alleppey at 12:55.
- **Sights:** Backwater cruise from 13:30 to 16:30.
- **Hotel:** H-ALLE-2, Hotel Lotus Alleppey, Rs 1,045.

I've put together a 5-day plan for 2 adults and your 3-year-old. It should cost about Rs 21,700–24,100, well under your Rs 52,000 budget. I couldn't tell whether the hotel prices already include the peak-season surcharge (hotels cost 40% more from 24 Dec to 2 Jan). The low figure assumes they do and the high figure assumes they don't.

The whole trip is by private taxi, so no trains are involved. That means your child doesn't need a berth. Sights are free for children under 5, so the plan only pays for 2 adults.

| Day | Travel | What you'll do | Where you stay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wed 30 Dec | Start in Kochi | Fort Kochi walk 10:00–12:00, Kathakali show 18:00–19:30 | Hotel Haveli Kochi (H-KOCH-2), Rs 1,440 |
| Thu 31 Dec | Taxi to Munnar, 08:00–12:35 | Tea Museum 13:30–14:45 | Hotel Orchid Munnar (H-MUNN-1), Rs 1,485 |
| Fri 1 Jan | — | Eravikulam viewpoint 09:00–11:30 | Hotel Orchid Munnar, Rs 1,530 |
| Sat 2 Jan | Taxi to Alleppey, 08:00–12:55 | Backwater cruise 13:30–16:30 | Hotel Lotus Alleppey (H-ALLE-2), Rs 1,570 |
| Sun 3 Jan | Taxi back to Kochi, 10:00–11:24 | Trip ends | — |

**Where the money goes:**
- **Hotels:** Rs 6,025 for 4 nights, or Rs 8,435 if the 40% surcharge still has to be added. All three of you share one room each night.
- **Taxis:** Rs 8,275 for one car on each of the three drives.
- **Sight tickets:** Rs 2,850 for 2 adults. The Fort Kochi walk is free.
- **Food allowance:** Rs 4,500, at Rs 300 per person per day.

**Before you go:**
- **Stairs:** None of these hotels has a lift, and the Kochi and Alleppey hotels have no ground-floor rooms. Think about this if you'll be bringing a pushchair.
- **Eravikulam viewpoint** is the only stop that isn't wheelchair-accessible.

The booking date is today, 15 Nov 2026. I've submitted the plan, so nothing else needs booking ahead.

No trains run from Chandigarh to Shimla, so both journeys are by private taxi. You need one taxi each time, which seats up to 4.

**Day 1 – Sun 20 Dec:** Taxi from Chandigarh at 09:00, arriving in Shimla at 13:05. Walk The Ridge and Mall Road from 14:00 to 16:00 (free). Stay at Hotel Orchid Shimla (H-SHIM-3), all three in one room.

**Day 2 – Mon 21 Dec:** Visit Kufri from 10:00 to 13:00. Second night at Hotel Orchid Shimla.

**Day 3 – Tue 22 Dec:** Taxi from Shimla at 08:00, arriving in Manali at 16:35. This is a long drive with nothing else planned. Stay at Hotel Grand Manali (H-MANA-4), one room for all three.

**Day 4 – Wed 23 Dec:** Solang Valley from 10:00 to 13:00, then Hadimba Temple from 14:30 to 15:30 (free). Second night at Hotel Grand Manali.

**Day 5 – Thu 24 Dec:** The trip ends in Manali. No travel or sightseeing is planned.

I've built the trip with overnight trains both ways, all booked today (15 Nov) in General quota. There are no hotel nights, because you sleep on the train both nights. Fares and entry fees come to Rs 2,460, well under your Rs 18,000 budget; food money is extra.

- **Fri 4 Dec:** Train 13058, Sleeper class, leaves Bengaluru at 19:30 and reaches Goa at 07:01 on 5 Dec. 15 seats are free.
- **Sat 5 Dec:** Basilica of Bom Jesus (free) from 09:00 to 10:00, then Fort Aguada from 11:00 to 12:00 (Rs 50 each). The afternoon is free. Train 13878, Sleeper class, leaves Goa at 21:15 and reaches Bengaluru at 10:02 on 6 Dec. 9 seats are free.
- **Sun 6 Dec:** Back in Bengaluru by mid-morning.

**Why only one full day in Goa:** The return train I first wanted (18867 on 5 Dec) is waitlisted. On 6 Dec, the day train back is only on RAC, so it can't be booked. The overnight trains that day reach Bengaluru on 7 Dec, a day after your trip ends.

**Optional upgrade:** If you'd rather have a hotel to rest in during the day on 5 Dec, Hotel Sunrise Goa (H-GOA-1) is Rs 1,230 for one room for 3. It's still within budget, but it isn't in the plan.

I've planned the trip and it fits the budget: about Rs 15,900 for 4 adults out of Rs 40,000. Both trains are confirmed, but they're overnight, so you get one full day and one half day in Goa.

**Day 1, Thu 24 Dec – leave Mumbai**
- Train 17521, Mumbai 22:40 → Goa 10:59 next morning, sleeper class (SL), 4 seats.
- 7 seats were free when I checked; 5 of them are lower berths.

**Day 2, Fri 25 Dec – Goa**
- Arrive 10:59.
- Basilica of Bom Jesus 13:00–14:00 (free).
- Fort Aguada 15:00–16:00 (Rs 50 per person).
- Night at Hotel Sunrise Goa (H-GOA-1), 2 rooms with 2 guests each.

**Day 3, Sat 26 Dec – Goa, then head home**
- Beach day at Palolem 09:00–13:00 (free).
- Train 18114, Goa 19:30 → Mumbai 07:35 next morning, AC 2-tier (2A), 4 seats. 20 seats were free.

**Day 4, Sun 27 Dec – back in Mumbai at 07:35**

**Why it's set up this way**
- **Return train:** The cheaper return trains are waitlisted on both 26 and 27 Dec, in every class except one. AC 2-tier on the 26 Dec train was the only confirmed option, so you travel back a night early. That's why the trip ends at 07:35 on the 27th.
- **Outbound train:** The 23:20 train is waitlisted. A day train leaving at 15:40 has seats, but it gets in at 02:45, so I didn't use it.
- **Flights:** Flying would cost about Rs 52,000 for four people, over your budget.

|---|---|
| Train out (SL) | 1,620 |
| Train back (2A) | 5,900 |
| Hotel, 1 night, 2 rooms | 3,370 |
| Fort Aguada tickets | 200 |
| Food allowance (budget-hotel rate, 4 people, 4 days) | 4,800 |

I've planned and submitted a 3-day Goa trip for 2 adults. It starts and ends in **Bengaluru**, because every train from Mumbai to Goa or back on these dates was waitlisted. The only confirmed seats I found were on the Bengaluru route. The total is about **Rs 8,060**, well under your Rs 30,000 budget.

**Bookings to make today (2026-11-15), General quota**
- **31 Dec:** Train 13259, Bengaluru to Goa, leaves 23:20 and arrives 1 Jan at 11:45. You'd be in 2-tier AC (2A), where 4 seats are left. No lower berths are free, so you may get upper berths.
- **2 Jan:** Train 17056, Goa to Bengaluru, leaves 13:10 and arrives 23:13. You'd be in AC chair car (CC), where 31 seats are open. This is a day train with seats, not berths.

**Day by day**
- **31 Dec:** You spend New Year's Eve night on the train.
- **1 Jan:** Arrive in Goa. Visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus (13:00–14:00, free), then Fort Aguada (15:00–16:00, Rs 50 each). Stay the night at Hotel Sunrise Goa (H-GOA-1), one room for both of you.
- **2 Jan:** Beach day at Palolem, 07:00–11:00, then the 13:10 train home.

**Cost breakdown**
| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Train to Goa (1,405 × 2) | 2,810 |
| Train home (815 × 2) | 1,630 |
| Hotel, 1 night | 1,720 |
| Fort Aguada tickets | 100 |
| Food allowance (300 × 2 people × 3 days) | 1,800 |
| **Total** | **~8,060** |

- **Flights:** at Rs 4,030 or more per person, they cost far more.
- **Ram Mandir:** darshan closes at 11:30, before you could reach Ayodhya, so the plan uses Hanuman Garhi instead.

- **29 June:** Rest day to get used to the altitude.
- **30 June:** Shanti Stupa, 10:00 to 11:00 (free entry).
- **1 July:** Leh Palace, 10:00 to 11:30.

- **4 July (Sun):** Fly Leh to Delhi on IX191, 13:20 to 15:04.

I've put together a 5-day plan for Kochi, Munnar and Alleppey, 22–26 December, for 2 adults and your 6-year-old. It comes to roughly ₹21,700, well under your ₹40,000 budget. All travel is by private taxi, with one taxi for the 3 of you. You stay in budget hotels, all 3 in one room each night.

| Date | Travel | Night | Sights |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22 Dec (Tue) | Start in Kochi | Hotel Haveli Kochi (H-KOCH-1) | Fort Kochi walk 10:00–12:00; Kathakali show 18:00–19:30 |
| 23 Dec | Kochi → Munnar taxi, 08:00–12:35 | Hotel Orchid Munnar (H-MUNN-1) | Tea Museum 14:00–15:15 |
| 24 Dec | No travel | Hotel Orchid Munnar | Eravikulam viewpoint 09:00–11:30 |
| 25 Dec | Munnar → Alleppey taxi, 08:00–12:55 | Hotel Sunrise Alleppey (H-ALLE-1) | Backwater cruise 13:30–16:30; Houseboat evening cruise 17:00–19:00 |
| 26 Dec | Alleppey → Kochi taxi, 10:00–11:24 | Trip ends | — |

**Approximate cost:**
- **Hotels (4 nights):** ₹5,345
- **Taxis:** ₹8,275 (₹3,350 + ₹3,565 + ₹1,360)
- **Tickets:** about ₹3,560. Your child pays half price.
- **Food:** about ₹4,500, at ₹300 per person per day for budget hotels.

**Things to know:**
- **Peak season:** From 24 December hotel prices go up by 40%. The Munnar room costs ₹1,470 that night instead of ₹1,080. These higher prices are already included above.
- **Houseboat:** The evening cruise is free, but you aren't sleeping on a houseboat. A houseboat night would cost ₹8,370 or more instead of ₹1,695 at the hotel. That would still fit your budget if you'd like to switch.
- **Eravikulam viewpoint:** It isn't wheelchair-accessible.

I've submitted the plan. Nothing is booked until it's confirmed.

**होटल:** Hotel Residency Varanasi (H-VARA-4) में 2 रातें, 18 और 19 दिसंबर। यहाँ लिफ्ट और ग्राउंड फ्लोर के कमरे हैं और सात्विक भोजन मिलता है। दो कमरे लिए हैं, हर कमरे में 2 लोग।

- **18 दिसंबर (शुक्रवार):** शाम 18:30–19:45 गंगा आरती। प्रवेश मुफ़्त है।

- **20 दिसंबर:** होटल से चेक-आउट। इस दिन कोई गतिविधि नहीं रखी है।

| **कुल** | | **₹15,660** |

यानी लगभग ₹12,340 बचते हैं।

- आपने यह नहीं बताया कि यात्रा कहाँ से शुरू होगी। इसलिए वाराणसी आने-जाने की ट्रेन या फ्लाइट योजना में शामिल नहीं है, और न ही उसका खर्च। अगर आप अपना शहर बता दें तो मैं यात्रा जोड़कर देख सकता हूँ कि सब कुछ बजट में आता है या नहीं।
